_comment: Declared open-keyed maps for the schema INFERENCE (map-ness is a schema fact, never inferred from instance key counts). `path` may contain '*' segments (each matches exactly one map key) so maps nested inside map items are declarable — a new bridge token or reward coin must extend the DATA, not the schema. `networks` declares where each map must exist: check-consistency.mjs FAILS if a declared map is missing/untraversable (a path typo or a data regression must never read as 'nothing to check' — review finding) and if an undeclared one appears. Top-level `symbols` and `packages` are absent on purpose: their schemas are hand-written in scripts/gen_schema.py (TOP), which is the sole source of their map-ness. base:'symbols' maps are checked ⊆ the symbol universe ('*' paths included); base:'open' maps are unconstrained keyspaces (presence-checked only). The base classification is additionally pinned in check-consistency.mjs's SYMBOL_KEYED_MAPS contract — flipping or removing one here alone fails CI. This _comment convention is for the three tool-owned schema/*.json files only — a _comment in the served DATA fails the generator (audit P5).
